lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  have der' : Typing Γ t τ := der
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case var mem => exact absurd mem (by simp)
  case app t₁ _ _ t₂ l r ih_l ih_r =>
    right
    obtain (val_l | ⟨t₁', red_l⟩) := ih_l rfl l
    · obtain (val_r | ⟨t₂', red_r⟩) := ih_r rfl r
      · obtain ⟨σ₀, t₁₀, rfl⟩ := l.canonical_form_abs val_l
        exact ⟨_, Red.abs val_l.lc val_r⟩
      · exact ⟨_, Red.appᵣ val_l red_r⟩
    · exact ⟨_, Red.appₗ r.wf.2.1 red_l⟩
  case tapp σ' der sub ih =>
    right
    obtain (val | ⟨t₁', red⟩) := ih rfl der
    · obtain ⟨σ₀, t₁₀, rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_tabs val
      exact ⟨_, Red.tabs val.lc (Sub.wf _ _ _ sub).2.1.lc⟩
    · exact ⟨_, Red.tapp (Sub.wf _ _ _ sub).2.1.lc red⟩
  case let' t₁ σ t₂ τ L der h ih _ =>
    right
    have body₂ : t₂.body := ⟨L, fun x hx => (h x hx).wf.2.1⟩
    obtain (val | ⟨t₁', red⟩) := ih rfl der
    · exact ⟨_, Red.let_body val body₂⟩
    · exact ⟨_, Red.let_bind red body₂⟩
  case inl der _ ih =>
    obtain (val | ⟨t', red⟩) := ih rfl der
    · exact .inl (Value.inl val)
    · exact .inr ⟨_, Red.inl red⟩
  case inr der _ ih =>
    obtain (val | ⟨t', red⟩) := ih rfl der
    · exact .inl (Value.inr val)
    · exact .inr ⟨_, Red.inr red⟩
  case case t₁ _ _ t₂ _ t₃ L der h₂ h₃ ih _ _ =>
    right
    obtain (val | ⟨t₁', red⟩) := ih rfl der
    · obtain ⟨t₁₀, (e|e)⟩ := der.canonical_form_sum val
      · subst e
        cases val with | inl v =>
          exact ⟨_, Red.case_inl v ⟨L, fun x hx => (h₂ x hx).wf.2.1⟩ ⟨L, fun x hx => (h₃ x hx).wf.2.1⟩⟩
      · subst e
        cases val with | inr v =>
          exact ⟨_, Red.case_inr v ⟨L, fun x hx => (h₂ x hx).wf.2.1⟩ ⟨L, fun x hx => (h₃ x hx).wf.2.1⟩⟩
    · exact ⟨_, Red.case red ⟨L, fun x hx => (h₂ x hx).wf.2.1⟩ ⟨L, fun x hx => (h₃ x hx).wf.2.1⟩⟩
  case sub der _ ih => exact ih rfl der
  case abs => exact .inl (Value.abs der'.wf.2.1)
  case tabs => exact .inl (Value.tabs der'.wf.2.1)

  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  have der' : Typing Γ t τ := der
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case var mem => grind
  case app t₁ _ _ t₂ l r ih_l ih_r =>
    right
    cases ih_l rfl l with
    | inl val_l =>
        cases ih_r rfl r with
        | inl val_r =>
            have ⟨σ, t₁, eq⟩ := l.canonical_form_abs val_l
            exists t₁ ^ᵗᵗ t₂
            grind
        | inr red_r =>
            obtain ⟨t₂', _⟩ := red_r
            exists t₁.app t₂'
            grind
    | inr red_l =>
        obtain ⟨t₁', _⟩ := red_l
        exists t₁'.app t₂
        grind
  case tapp σ' der _ ih =>
    right
    specialize ih rfl der
    cases ih with
    | inl val =>
        obtain ⟨_, t, _⟩ := der.canonical_form_tabs val
        exists t ^ᵗᵞ σ'
        grind
    | inr red =>
        obtain ⟨t', _⟩ := red
        exists .tapp t' σ'
        grind
  case let' t₁ σ t₂ τ L der _ ih _ =>
    right
    cases ih rfl der with
    | inl _ =>
        exists t₂ ^ᵗᵗ t₁
        grind
    | inr red =>
        obtain ⟨t₁', _⟩ := red
        exists t₁'.let' t₂
        grind
  case inl der _ ih =>
    cases (ih rfl der) with
    | inl val => grind
    | inr red =>
        right
        obtain ⟨t', _⟩ := red
        exists .inl t'
        grind
  case inr der _ ih =>
    cases (ih rfl der) with
    | inl val => grind
    | inr red =>
        right
        obtain ⟨t', _⟩ := red
        exists .inr t'
        grind
  case case t₁ _ _ t₂ _ t₃ _ der _ _ ih _ _ =>
    right
    cases ih rfl der with
    | inl val =>
        have ⟨t₁, lr⟩ := der.canonical_form_sum val
        cases lr <;> [exists t₂ ^ᵗᵗ t₁; exists t₃ ^ᵗᵗ t₁] <;> grind
    | inr red =>
        obtain ⟨t₁', _⟩ := red
        exists t₁'.case t₂ t₃
        grind
  case sub => grind
  case abs σ _ τ L _ _=>

    apply LC.abs L

    · grind
